raw_comment:
What do you notice? I noticed that a very large amount of States are going through severe drought, which is shown in different shades of yellows and oranges. The darkest ones being the most hydrated states, and the lightest the most dehydrated. A lot of the states are going through immense drought.

What do you wonder? 
I wonder if the high levels of drought will continue to raise.

How does this relate to you and your community?
This relates to my community and all of the United States. Climate change has been a really high topic that isn't spoken about enough. Climate changes and high weather have been causing a lot of environmental issues, and the government is yet to take action over this. If this issue isn't looked upon or resolved, it may lead to bigger problems for everyone and the planets safety.

What’s going on in this graph? "Will Climate Change be the cause of environmental issues forever?"
